description: Replaces the world with a fresh one, keeping settings, content and address; for an earlier world use restoreBackup instead. A running server disconnects its players and comes back online on the new world. A reset backup of the current world is taken first and earlier backups are kept, but the archived world of a long-asleep server is discarded. The user can also reset it on the Danger tab of the webUrl from listServers (webUrl followed by danger/). Returns the server.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: resetServer
title: Reset a server's world
